adaptations: Copied self-contained raw and Aspire fixture trees, not submodules.
Raw control removes inactive ServiceDefaults project/references, OTel startup hooks, and checkpoint documentation.
Raw Bash launcher accepts run-scoped ports and Compose project; PowerShell/manual helpers are omitted to avoid unsafe fixed-port alternatives.
Aspire AppHost project paths are relative to the self-contained fixture.
Both fixtures pin PostgreSQL 18.3 and Redis 8.6 to match the Aspire 13.6 integration defaults.
Both fixtures select a stable .NET 10 SDK via global.json; the file-based AppHost opts out of central package management for its explicit directives.
Aspire container and data-volume names require a unique BENCH_RUN_ID; no persistent resources are reused.
Both launchers use npm ci so normal dependency installation preserves the snapshotted lockfile.
Both fixture READMEs document their own launcher without describing the other variant.
